title: Set up the shared repository
done_when: Both partners can access the repo; planning files are committed; both understand the first tasks.

title: Agree on roles and prediction format
done_when: Confirm Python, ownership and full-word suggestion format; record decisions in INTERFACES.md.

title: Clarify evaluation split
done_when: Ask how 70/30 and five-fold CV fit together; record instructor guidance before formal experiments.

title: Choose and log dataset sources
done_when: Log at least 10 independent Python projects with URL, license, exact commit and included paths.

title: Prepare repeatable dataset and splits
done_when: Exclude generated/vendor code consistently; deduplicate; save project-level splits, seed and file hashes; keep raw code out of Git.

title: Build word n-gram models
done_when: Support n=1..10, smoothing and unseen contexts; document tokenization; test on small known sequences.

title: Build character n-gram models
done_when: Support n=1..10; generate full-word candidates with length/stop limits; expose the agreed suggestion interface.

title: Try a parser on incomplete code
done_when: Compare candidate parser behaviour on unfinished expressions; select an error-tolerant approach and document failure cases.

title: Build the AST prediction baseline
done_when: Produce ranked word candidates from prefix structure; document candidate rules, syntax checks and fallback; never use hidden future text.

title: Build shared contexts and metrics
done_when: Score the same held-out word targets for every model; verify exact-match accuracy and character edit distance with hand-worked cases.

title: Run five-fold model comparisons
done_when: Fit on each training fold only; save per-fold results for every n plus mean and sample SD; record runtime settings and failures.

title: Evaluate AST and hybrid models
done_when: Kamso leads syntax integration; David leads experiment runs; compare AST and a documented hybrid with n-gram baselines using the same contexts.

title: Build a basic editor with fake predictions
done_when: Typing shows up to five suggestions; selecting one replaces the partial word; use a fake model first so work can start immediately.

title: Connect two models and handle failures
done_when: Switch between two selected models; update suggestions as code changes; handle empty output/parser errors and check typing responsiveness.

title: Choose models and compare coding experience
done_when: Explain the choice using results; both try the same coding tasks with two models; record useful and bad suggestions and actual observations.

title: Prepare presentation and demonstration
done_when: Show problem, methods, results and limitations; rehearse the demo; confirm duration/format on Canvas before recording.

title: Finish report and reproduce results
done_when: Explain data, splits, methods, hybrid and metrics; include real tables and limitations; another partner reproduces the key run from README.

title: Review final submission and contributions
done_when: Check current Canvas deliverables; confirm teaching-team access; record actual contributions; one submits and the other verifies.
